### Born Blind
Author: Ryan Duncan
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-march-13-2013.html
Passage: John 9:3
Points:
- In Jesus' day, people viewed severe afflictions like blindness as divine punishment for personal or parental sin.
- Jesus immediately dispelled that assumption, revealing that God's power and glory would be displayed through the man's life.
- The miracle was not merely about physical healing, but about the renewal and restoration of the man's soul.
- Believers should avoid self-righteousness and judgment toward others, recognizing their own ongoing need for spiritual sight.

### Surrendering Our Whys
Author: Lysa TerKeurst
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-june-21-2018.html
Passage: John 9:3
Points:
- When experiencing pain, people frequently search for a reason or someone to blame.
- The disciples asked who had sinned, assuming the blind man was bearing the penalty of guilt.
- Jesus redirected their focus from blame to purpose, declaring that the works of God would be displayed in him.
- Faith invites believers to surrender unresolved questions and seek Christ's presence and spiritual perspective instead.
